title: Northgate Delivery & Installation Arrival Windows and Booking Lead Times
content:
Each Northgate Delivery & Installation service level offers its own arrival windows and its own range of delivery dates, stated in calendar days after the booking date: the earliest delivery date and the latest delivery date that can be booked.

| Service level | Arrival windows that can be booked | Earliest delivery date | Latest delivery date |
|---|---|---|---|
| Northgate Curbside Delivery | 08:00-12:00; 12:00-17:00 | 2 calendar days after booking | 30 calendar days after booking |
| Northgate Threshold Delivery | 08:00-12:00; 12:00-17:00 | 2 calendar days after booking | 30 calendar days after booking |
| Northgate Room of Choice Delivery | 08:00-12:00; 12:00-17:00; 17:00-21:00 | 3 calendar days after booking | 30 calendar days after booking |
| Northgate White Glove Delivery | 08:00-12:00; 12:00-17:00 | 3 calendar days after booking | 30 calendar days after booking |
| Northgate Appliance Delivery & Installation | 08:00-12:00; 12:00-17:00 | 3 calendar days after booking | 45 calendar days after booking |
| Northgate TV Delivery & Wall-Mount Installation | 12:00-17:00; 17:00-21:00 | 4 calendar days after booking | 30 calendar days after booking |

## Observations

- The evening window 17:00-21:00 is offered only by Northgate Room of Choice Delivery and Northgate TV Delivery & Wall-Mount Installation; the morning window 08:00-12:00 is not offered by TV Delivery & Wall-Mount Installation.
- Northgate Appliance Delivery & Installation reaches furthest ahead, to 45 calendar days after booking; every other level reaches 30.
- Northgate TV Delivery & Wall-Mount Installation needs the longest lead, 4 calendar days.

**Hypothetical calendar.** For a booking made on the 1st of a 31-day month, the earliest Threshold delivery date is the 3rd (2 calendar days after the booking date) and the earliest TV Delivery & Wall-Mount Installation date is the 5th (4 calendar days after); the latest Room of Choice date is the 31st (30 calendar days after).
